Our Story

Two ideas, one table.

Meethas by Samiksha began with a simple question: why should indulgent and wholesome live on separate shelves? Our cookies and brownies are baked the traditional way — real butter, real chocolate, no shortcuts. Alongside them sit our protein dips and seeded crackers, built for the days you want something nourishing that still feels special.

"Every box we send out carries our seal — because it's made the way we'd feed our own family."
